details.description:
Tian Tian (literally: 'More and More' in Chinese) is a 275-pound male giant panda at the National Zoo in Washington (DC). 
 The panda was born on August 27, 1997, at the China Conservation and Research Center for the Giant Panda at the Wolong National Nature Reserve in Sichuan Province.
